name: Create and deploy Apps in Ever Works for you
description: Lets app.ever.co create an App in your Ever Works workspace, and start a deployment of one, when an owner or admin of your organization asks for it there. Ever Works does the work as the person who asked, with the rights that person has in Ever Works.
revoke_effect: app.ever.co stops creating and deploying Apps in Ever Works for your organization at once. Apps and deployments that already exist stay in Ever Works, under your control there.
notes: Offered for Ever Works Cloud. No e-mail address or name of a person is sent: Ever Works takes the person from their own Ever ID sign-in. An owner or admin asks for each App and each deployment; nothing is created or deployed on its own.

scope.purpose: Say which Ever Works workspace the App belongs to
scope.retention: Ever Works keeps it with the App it creates or the deployment it starts. Ever Platform keeps no copy.

scope.purpose: Act as the person who asked: Ever Works checks their membership and rights itself
scope.retention: Ever Works keeps it with the App and the deployment as the person who asked. Ever Platform keeps no copy.

scope.retention: Ever Works keeps it with the App it creates or the deployment it starts. Ever Platform keeps no copy.
